reviewStatus.requestedBody: Your request is with the administrator. You can return here to check for updates.
reviewStatus.inReviewBody: The administrator is reviewing your information. We’ll make your report available here when it’s ready.
reviewStatus.completedBody: Your administrator-reviewed report is ready to read in WeightPilot.
reviewStatus.unknownBody: You can check this page for updates about your request.

dashboard.title: Welcome back, {name}
dashboard.description: A simple overview of your assessment, reports and private messages.
dashboard.heroPhotoAlt: Two people talking comfortably in a bright room.
dashboard.readyPhotoAlt: A woman enjoying a quiet moment by the window with a cup of tea.
dashboard.pendingPhotoAlt: A calm morning at home while the report is being prepared.
dashboard.readyBody: Your administrator-reviewed report has been available in your private WeightPilot space since {date}.
dashboard.inviteTitle: Know someone who would feel at home here?
dashboard.inviteBody: WeightPilot is a close-knit community built on personal recommendations. Invite people you know and trust who could benefit from personalised weight-management information.
dashboard.inviteStepCreate: Create an invitation in My Invitations.
dashboard.inviteStepShare: Share its seven-day link by email, WhatsApp, SMS or copy link.
dashboard.inviteStepJoin: Your friend can use the link to register and join the community.
dashboard.inviteNote: Each invitation is personal, single-use and expires after seven days. Please share it privately.
dashboard.requestedTitle: Your review request is awaiting review
dashboard.requestedBody: Your request has been received. We’ll update this space when the review begins.
dashboard.preparingBody: The administrator is reviewing your information. Your report will appear here when it has been delivered.
dashboard.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}

dashboardJourney.photoAlt: A woman enjoying a calm morning at home with a cup of tea.

new.intro: Let's find your next step towards your weight goal.
new.actionBody: Answer a few questions about your health and weight goals. We'll then prepare your personalised review.
new.privacy: About 2 minutes · Your answers stay private

draft.intro: Your answers have been saved. Pick up where you left off.
draft.actionBody: Continue from your saved answers. You can review everything before submitting.

awaiting.title: Your assessment is complete
awaiting.body: This earlier assessment has not entered review yet. Choose your report language and request a personalised review from your results page.

review.title: Your assessment is being reviewed
review.body: We've received your information and are preparing your personalised guidance. We'll let you know when it's ready.

report.title: Your personalised recommendation is ready
report.treatmentBody: Your reviewed report highlights this option in the context of your answers. It is not a decision about individual suitability or a prescription.
report.reviewBody: Your report explains what needs more individual review before an option can be highlighted. Open it for the full context and next steps.

request.caution: Request status records administrative next steps only. It is not a prescription or authorisation to supply medicine.

SUBMITTED.title: Your request has been received
SUBMITTED.body: Your details are saved. We'll review your request and share any next steps here.

UNDER_REVIEW.title: Your request is under review
UNDER_REVIEW.body: We're checking the information you submitted. You can open your request or ask a private question.

APPROVED_FOR_NEXT_STEPS.title: Next steps are available
APPROVED_FOR_NEXT_STEPS.body: An administrative update is ready in your request. Read it carefully and contact us privately if you have questions.

DECLINED.title: There is an update to your request
DECLINED.body: Open your request to read the response. You can continue the conversation privately if anything is unclear.

CANCELLED.title: Your request was cancelled
CANCELLED.body: You can review the request history and your report at any time.

1.title: Your assessment
1.body: Tell us about your goal and circumstances.

2.title: We review
2.body: Your answers enter a private review.

3.title: Your recommendation
3.body: Read your guidance and decide what to explore next.

reports.title: My Reports
reports.description: Read administrator-reviewed reports that have been successfully delivered to your account.
reports.emptyBody: When your personalised report is ready, you’ll find it here as well as in your email.
reports.questionAbout: Ask a question about your report
reports.questionAboutBody: Continue the conversation privately with the WeightPilot administrator.
reports.fullReportHint: Your reviewed guidance, context and any saved cost comparison.
reports.recommendedBody: Your report highlights this medicine for discussion. It does not establish suitability or prescribe a treatment; an independent qualified prescriber must assess the next steps.
reports.treatmentPathBody: See the illustrative starting reference and read more before requesting further administrative review.
reports.moreTreatmentsBody: Explore the other treatment information and compare the general considerations at your own pace.
reports.reportUnavailable: This report is not available. It may not have been delivered yet.
reports.errorBody: Please try again. Your report history has not been changed.
reports.savingsNote: Illustrative medicine costs for a hypothetical scenario only. Delivery, prescribing and other costs may be excluded. Pharmacy prices may change and included services may differ. This comparison does not indicate treatment suitability.

error.title: Something didn’t load
error.body: Please try again. Your private information has not been changed.
